commands.petting.summon.error.not_a_mob: Target entity is not a mob and cannot be tamed as a pet.
petting.configuration.title: Petting Configuration
petting.configuration.wiki_link: Need help? Visit the configuration guide on our wiki
petting.configuration.taming.maxHealthPe: The maximum health percentage a mob must be at or below to be tamed (0.0 to 100.0).
petting.configuration.taming.hostileMobs: If enabled, only hostile mobs must be weakened to the health threshold to be tamed. If disabled, all mobs must be weakened.
petting.configuration.taming.unsuccessfu: The percentage chance (0.0 to 100.0) that a taming attempt fails and consumes the treat.
petting.configuration.taming.untameableE: List of entity registry IDs (e.g. 'minecraft:warden' or 'modid:boss_name') that can never be tamed.
petting.configuration.taming.maxPetCount: The maximum number of pets a player can own at a time. Set to -1 for unlimited pets.
petting.configuration.feedback.enablePos: Whether to display positive feedback messages in chat.
petting.configuration.feedback.enableNeg: Whether to display negative feedback and warning messages in chat.
petting.action.already_tamed_other: This mob already belongs to someone else.
petting.action.already_vanilla_tamed: This mob has already bonded with someone through vanilla taming.
petting.action.too_healthy: This mob is too healthy to tame! Weaken it below %d%% health first.
petting.action.pet_limit_reached: You have reached your pet limit (%s)!
